class.name: ResonanceGeometry
class.brief_description: Base node that marks mesh surfaces for Steam Audio simulation.
class.description: Exposes mesh triangles to [ResonanceServer] for occlusion, transmission, and reverb. Normally must be a direct child of a [MeshInstance3D]. When [member geometry_override] is set, a [MeshInstance3D] parent is not required; a child of any [Node3D] suffices. Override mesh vertices are in this node's local space (use this node's transform). Assign a [ResonanceMaterial] per surface. All [ResonanceGeometry] nodes in the scene contribute to probe baking. Prefer [ResonanceStaticGeometry] for fixed world meshes and [ResonanceDynamicGeometry] for movers. For [member dynamic] objects on Embree, Default, or Radeon tracers, prefer a low-poly [member mesh_asset] from [method export_dynamic_mesh_to_asset] or [member geometry_override] over the full render mesh; scene commit cost scales with total mesh size. When [member ResonanceRuntimeConfig.scene_type] is Custom (Godot Physics), geometry is not uploaded to Phonon; use physics colliders for dynamic occlusion instead. See [member ResonanceRuntimeConfig.dynamic_scene_commit_min_interval] and [method ResonanceServer.get_simulation_worker_timing] ([code]us_simulator_commit[/code], [code]main_us_dynamic_transform_enqueue[/code]).

members.member: Acoustic material for this surface. Controls absorption (low, mid, high), scattering, and transmission. Use presets under addons/nexus_resonance/materials/ (e.g. concrete, glass, wood).

Pre-exported mesh bytes for dynamic geometry. When set and [member dynamic] is true, loads via iplStaticMeshLoad for faster runtime and better stability. Assigned automatically by Export Dynamic Mesh on [ResonanceDynamicGeometry].

Optional simplified mesh for Steam Audio. When set, used instead of the parent [MeshInstance3D] mesh for export and runtime (e.g. BoxMesh to cut polygon count). A [MeshInstance3D] parent is not required when this is set.
When true and [member geometry_override] is set, draws the override mesh as a semi-transparent green overlay in the editor viewport only.
When true, exports acoustic geometry from all child nodes that have a [MeshInstance3D] or [member geometry_override]. Same idea as Steam Audio Export All Children. Hidden on dynamic geometry nodes.

When true, geometry is instanced and updated for moving objects. Enable path validation ([member ResonanceRuntimeConfig.path_validation_enabled] or [member ResonancePlayerConfig.path_validation_override] Enabled) when movers can block baked paths. [ResonanceStaticGeometry] and [ResonanceDynamicGeometry] fix this flag and hide it in the inspector.

method.name: get_mesh_bake_transform
method.description: World transform from mesh vertex space to global space: this node's global transform when [member geometry_override] is set, otherwise the parent [MeshInstance3D] global transform (or this node's global transform if there is no mesh parent). Matches static scene export and runtime acoustic registration.

method.name: export_dynamic_mesh_to_asset
method.description: Exports the mesh (parent [MeshInstance3D] or [member geometry_override] when set) to a [ResonanceGeometryAsset] at [param p_path] ([code].tres[/code] or [code].res[/code] under [code]{{bake_output}}/dynamics/[/code] per Project Settings) and assigns [member mesh_asset]. Works in the editor without running the scene. Requires a [Node3D] parent; [MeshInstance3D] is only required when [member geometry_override] is unset.

method.name: refresh_geometry
method.description: Recreates Steam Audio meshes from the current mesh source. Prefer [method sync_reflection_debug_viz] when only toggling reflection debug visualization. Use after changing [member material], [member geometry_override], or the parent mesh at runtime.

method.name: sync_reflection_debug_viz
method.description: Updates reflection debug overlay geometry only (CPU ray-hit visualization). Does not remove or recreate Steam Audio static or instanced meshes. Prefer this over [method refresh_geometry] when toggling debug flags so dynamic Embree geometry stays valid.

method.name: flush_dynamic_acoustic_transform
method.description: For [member dynamic] geometry with an instanced mesh: applies the current transform on the simulation thread path immediately (under [code]simulation_mutex[/code]), clears any queued worker update for this mesh, and marks the scene for commit. Call when an animation or tween finishes so dynamic occlusion and path validation match the final pose, especially when [member ResonanceRuntimeConfig.dynamic_scene_commit_min_interval] is greater than 0.
